title: Unverified ownership in Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow a privileged attacker with access…
description: A vulnerability in Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware allows a privileged attacker with access to a malicious hypervisor to overwrite guest memory if segmented Reverse Map Table (RMP) is enabled. This could lead to loss of guest data integrity. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating and a CVSS score of 5.9. No affected software versions or patches are specified in the available data.
